name: ts-fullstack-template
description: Reusable full-stack TypeScript monorepo template: NestJS + Mercurius + Drizzle + Effect backend, React + TanStack + Tailwind client.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && npm run build -w @repo/server && npm run build -w @repo/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @repo/server && npm run lint -w @repo/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @repo/server && npm run typecheck -w @repo/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @repo/contracts && npm run test -w @repo/server && npm run test -w @repo/client
